note: Written before reading the six reports, from my own measurements of the artifacts as captured this session. The rule is the lower of critic and builder per category, so a number here is a ceiling on what I am claiming, not a request. Where I could not measure a thing, I say so and score as though the critic will find it.
what_i_will_not_argue_with: Two of the seventeen artifacts are missing. 09_two_devices.png and 16_setup_android.png need an Android device and this container has no /dev/kvm; the three routes tried are measured in docs/PHONES.md and nothing stands in for them.

08_state_propagating.mp4 is required to show both devices' screens in sequence and shows one. The far phone is the app's own spine in the host role and has no screen by construction; a browser page cannot take that role because the host binds a listening socket. Same missing screen as 09 and 16, written down in docs/PHONES.md.

Every reliability report says transport: local. The tailnet transport exists and coldstart.json records a real two-node run from the session that had a key; no TS_AUTHKEY was in this session's environment and the brief forbids asking again.
The DeskStamp face is still not built — it wants about five hours on one core here — so the stamped furniture is set in TeoHand and app/pubspec.yaml says so.
The seeded photographs are renders. A critic called them abstract CG and that is a fair reading of the darkest few; nothing was done about it this cycle.

The desk's medullary rays were changed from summed sinusoids to placed strokes, and I could NOT reproduce the hairline pitch a critic measured last cycle. Two methods are recorded in blender/shell/desk.py. If the finding comes back, it stands: I have no measurement that closes it.

messenger_reliability.why: Twelve of the thirteen seeded scenes are paired with the far phone and connected on the whole year (link connected, 14,062 events and up; the two unpaired are the fresh-install artifacts, which is what they are for). 13 stages the whole grammar down real paths: two messages that go sent then read by a marker the far phone sent, one still in flight, one refused, a reaction, a reply, an edit through the composer's own send, and a row taken back. 02 frames a voice note beside a video, found by asking the thread where those kinds are rather than by a row number. Search is newest first with a reason on every hit; the viewer covers the desk. Held back by the missing second device, by transport: local in every report, and by a first launch that still costs 12.3 s to import the year (2.5-2.7 s on a kept store).

material_truth.why: The fold was the thing that cost this row for three cycles and it is fixed at both ends: the camera tilt parameter rotated the camera on the spot instead of orbiting, and under that the flaps were folding beneath the sheet, which only a top-down camera could hide. All 240 frames are above the paper floor (worst 2.26, median 3.58 against 1.2) and the clip shows the packet, the flap standing with its shadow across the third below it, and the creases catching light on the settled sheet. Repeated letters: the twin share on the hero crop is 0.092 against 0.30 last cycle, from a cascade whose step comes from the preceding letter. Ink is a colour through a coverage plate now, so a stroke is not one value end to end. Held back because DeskStamp is unbuilt, because the desk finding is unclosed by my own admission, and because I have not measured the fold against a real photograph of a real letter.

emotional_transmission.why: 07 is shot on the receiving phone across four arrivals on three surfaces, 6.74 s, no repeated frame; the page lifts on the pattern, the object lands, rests and is put away, and the pattern is annotated on the timeline as the brief requires — with no words on it, because the caption was an instrument printed over the app and four critics said so. 15 goes through the vocabulary family by family and ends on the one the couple's own feeling is in. haptics.json has 36 feelings, no two alike. A feeling's object is no longer clipped by the paper it arrives on: object and shadow are packed in their own frames and the box is the object. Held back because there is still no vibrator anywhere in the evidence, because the clip's sound is the asset file placed at the arrival rather than the running app's output, and because the two-device frame this row turns on does not exist.

coherence.why: One kind of event is one kind of paper wherever it is met: the stock a type is on lives in one place and every module asks it, with a test that fails when a module names its own. The module events are their own renderers in the thread and Moments draws the same event on the same stock. The search affordance is a slip with an edge and a shadow rather than ink over whatever scrolled under it. Held back because nothing in the capture shows the Android side at all, because Us still draws its rows from its own bodies even though they now agree about paper, and because the code half of this row is mine to judge and I am not the one who should.

anti_goal.why: No flat fill in a paper colour outside the paper widget; no emoji shapes or prize tokens among the objects; no counts, no badges, no streaks; every displayed string passes a voice lint that now names the rules it applied and lists all 115 strings it read, because a check reporting a count and an empty list cannot be audited. The instrument readout is off the picture. Held back because the seeded photographs are still renders that read as renders, and because the haptic lane, capture-only, is furniture on the frame however carefully it is placed.
